name: EDCI 3100W
title: Multicultural Education, Equity and Social Justice
description: Introduction to multicultural education. Includes the nature and purposes of schooling, the relationship between diversity, schooling and society, and the concepts and practices of multicultural education and equity pedagogy.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; open only to students in the Integrated Bachelor's/Master's Teacher Prep Program.
